architecture.note: The integration sits between Cloud/ChatGPT and a disposable n8n instance. It must not depend on the contents of any workflow and must survive instance recreation.

manual_per_new_instance: Set the instance-specific env vars: N8N_<INSTANCE>_BASE_URL and N8N_<INSTANCE>_API_KEY (these change on each recreation and are not permanent).
Create an n8n API key with the minimal READ scopes in Settings -> API (workflow:read / workflow:list, credentials:list, data table read).
Re-create credential secrets in the n8n UI: Telegram bot token, Google OAuth, OpenAI key.
Confirm Google OAuth identity / GSC property access on the new instance.
Only when migration is authorized and ready: switch Telegram webhook ownership (SOURCE off first, then TARGET on). Never leave both receiving at once.
